CROP 2025 (PA). Latex overflow in R14 comes from biweekly collection, so collect weekly. There has been no weeding in R14.

YOUNG MATURE AND IMMATURE. P18 (Agro): satisfactory, with less Mg deficiency. Pale palms grow in low-lying waterlogged spots (drainage needed).
